headline: Full market pass done for the strongest 47 candidates. Each lot shows sold prices, unsold results and asking prices separately. Only sold prices set a maximum bid, and comps over 24 months old are flagged.
coverage_note: The catalogue index lists 365 lots and all 365 were scanned. Lot numbers in 970 to 1353 that are not listed in the catalogue index (19 of them) are simply not in the sale. cdids past the end redirect to the catalogue index.
